page.title: Savings goals
page.description: Plan your savings with priorities, deadlines and contributions

widget.empty: Create a goal to track your savings.

view.emptyDescription: A holiday, a car or an emergency fund — set a goal and track your progress.

form.invalid: Enter a target amount and savings account, and check the allocation limit.
form.description: Household savings with a clear deadline and contribution plan.
form.name: Name
form.manualHint: Manual contributions do not change account balances or household income.
form.expensesHint: Based on posted expenses for full calendar months, including months with no expenses. The amount updates automatically.
form.allocationHint: A single goal without a limit receives the full balance. Shared accounts are allocated by priority: up to the first goal’s target or limit, then the next. Equal priorities use a fixed order. Transfers increase the account’s total balance.
form.scheduleHint: Editing a goal does not change its existing schedule. Turn the schedule off and set it up again to update it.

card.expenseMonths: {count, plural, one {# month of expenses} other {# months of expenses}}

detail.allocationHint: A single goal without a limit receives the full balance. Shared account funds are allocated by priority up to each target or limit. Withdrawals reduce progress. Archiving a goal releases its allocation.
detail.automationHint: Automatic contributions require an allocation limit that covers the full target and exchange rates for higher priority goals.
detail.addExpenses: Add expenses for previous months to calculate the amount.
detail.chartDescription: Actual savings and two separate projections: your average pace over 3 months and planned transactions. These are not added together. Projections cover up to 10 years, using today’s exchange rates and emergency fund target.
detail.pace: Average pace over the last 3 months: {amount}/month
detail.emergency: Emergency fund: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} × average expenses over {window, plural, one {# full month} other {# full months}}.

automation.stopDescription: Future transfers will be removed. Posted transfers remain in your history.

archive.title: Archive goal?
archive.description: Future automatic contributions will stop. Your history is kept and the account funds become available to other goals.
archive.restoreDescription: The goal will receive account allocations again. You can set up automatic contributions again.

history.title: Contribution history
history.accountDescription: Changes to the goal’s allocated amount by account transaction date, valued using current exchange rates and allocations.
history.manualDescription: Manual contributions and withdrawals. To correct an entry, add an opposite contribution with a comment.

funding.invalid: Enter an amount and date. For a currency transfer, also enter the amount received.
funding.title: Add money to goal
funding.autoDescription: We’ll create monthly planned transfers up to the goal’s deadline. The amount is based on the remaining contributions. Confirm each transfer when it happens.
funding.manualDescription: Record a contribution or withdrawal from your savings.
funding.accountDescription: Record a posted transfer to the savings account. Funds are allocated to goals by priority.
funding.noDates: No available dates before the deadline
funding.schedule: Amount received: {scheduled, select, yes {{amount} × {count, plural, one {# contribution} other {# contributions}}} other {No available dates before the deadline}}. Includes funding gaps for higher priority goals sharing the account. The rate is fixed at creation and can be adjusted when confirming each transfer.

warnings.missingRate: Missing {currency} exchange rate. Goal progress and projections are incomplete.
